title: Number bonds to ten on your fingers
examples: How do I learn number bonds to ten?

explain.say: Hold up both hands. You have 10 fingers. Number bonds to 10 are pairs of numbers that make 10. Look at the board. 7 and 3 fill the frame.

draw.text: Number bonds to ten on your fingers

explain.say: Put 4 fingers down. How many fingers are still up? 6 fingers are up. So 6 and 4 make 10. Look at the board: 6 counters and 4 more.
Now put just 2 fingers down. 8 fingers are still up. 8 and 2 make 10. Say it with me: 8 and 2 make 10.
Here are 5 and 5. That is one whole hand and the other whole hand. Each row of the frame holds 5. Together they make 10.
Look at all the pairs on the board. Each pair makes 10. You can turn each pair around. 3 and 7 make 10, and so do 7 and 3. Today, show every pair on your fingers.

faq.q: What is a number bond to ten?
faq.a: It is a pair of numbers that add up to ten, like seven and three, or six and four.

faq.q: How do I use my fingers for number bonds?
faq.a: Hold up ten fingers and put some down. The fingers down and the fingers still up are a pair that makes ten.

faq.q: Why learn number bonds to ten?
faq.a: They make adding and taking away much faster. If you know seven and three make ten, you also know ten take away three is seven.

faq.q: What are all the number bonds to ten?
faq.a: Zero and ten, one and nine, two and eight, three and seven, four and six, and five and five. Plus all of those turned around.
asks: List the number bonds to ten

faq.q: How can I practise number bonds?
faq.a: Play a finger game. A grown-up shows some fingers, and you say how many more make ten. You can also use a ten frame with counters.

facts: Not counting turn-arounds, there are six pairs that make ten: 0 and 10, 1 and 9, 2 and 8, 3 and 7, 4 and 6, and 5 and 5.
Adding works in any order: 7 + 3 and 3 + 7 both make 10.

quiz.say: Look at the sum. Which number goes with 6 to make 10?

wrong.0: 6 and 3 make 9, which is 1 less than 10.
wrong.2: 6 and 5 make 11, which is 1 more than 10.

quiz.say: Aoife holds up 10 fingers. She puts 2 fingers down. How many fingers are up?
quiz.show: 🖐️🖐️ 10 fingers. 2 go down. How many are up?
quiz.why: 10 take away 2 is 8. You can check: 8 and 2 make 10.

wrong.0: 2 is the number of fingers that went down.
wrong.1: 7 fingers up would mean 3 fingers went down.
